records.rule: Keep one ordered speech lane per channel and use independent channel objects for simultaneous conversations.
Python is an implementation resource behind resident Macrospace objects, never the orchestration authority and never a subprocess bridge.
Speech sees PCM; SIP/RTP/device systems keep signalling, codec, packet and device authority.
Never return a server-local temporary file path as a remote RPC result. Publish durable material identity or fail closed.
Unary JSON-RPC is not the PCM streaming transport. Keep streaming on explicit stream/media bindings.
Speech does not authenticate request headers or JSON identity claims. Platform HTTPS/LDAP authority proves identity and authorizes RPC operations.
